framework: UIKit (View layout, appearance, animation and haptics)
bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/autolayout.rs, springboard/ui/src/constraint.rs, springboard/ui/src/anim.rs, springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs, springboard/render/src/appearance.rs, springboard/ui/src/material_style.rs, springboard/ui/src/list_content.rs, springboard/ui/src/background_configuration.rs, springboard/ui/src/reserved_region.rs
summary: Auto Layout with a Cassowary solver, layout guides and safe area insets, dark and light appearance, glass and materials, implicit and keyframe animations, physics and transitions exist. Haptic feedback is a single pulse, and appearance proxies, bar appearance and motion effects are missing. Declarative list content and background configurations and declared reserved regions exist as models, not yet painted by the toolkit.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: incremental simplex solver with priorities and an anchor API; opt-in for views

features.apple: UILayoutGuide, layout margins, readable content guide
features.note: margins and content top from the window size; no readable content width guide

Layout carries a top inset (Configure.safe_top) and a bottom inset (Configure.safe_bottom, which the shell fills with the home zone plus keyboard height on a handheld); no side insets for rounded corners and no safe-area layout guide object

built on parity/team-p-list-config; not yet verified on the tablet. Declared regions with identifier, kind (keyboard, window controls, system), margins and active flag; free_area and region_at; no view-tree wiring yet, so the keyboard and window controls do not declare their regions
light and dark appearance with semantic colours; apps follow the system setting
glass and prominent glass styles, container, union and background extension model
styles come from the shared kit; apps cannot restyle bars globally, which is acceptable for a consistent look

built on parity/team-p-list-config; not yet verified on the tablet. Declarative list content (text, secondary text, image, margins, per-state colours) with a layout function, and background configuration (per-state fill and stroke, corner radius, edge insets); the list cell and view paint integration is not wired yet
transactions, curves, springs, key-path and keyframe animation; view properties animate through ViewState
retargeting without a jump for springs; no scrubbing or pausing animator object
rigid body world with gravity and collisions; no attachment, snap or push behaviors
raw sensor values reach apps; no parallax effect object
Ctx::haptic sends one pulse to the shell vibrator; no intensity, style or selection and notification patterns
line glyphs named after the system symbol set; effects model

gaps: Bottom and side safe area insets
Haptic generators with styles and intensities
List cell and view paint integration for the configurations, and reserved regions declared by the keyboard and window controls
